message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-09-09 13:10 IST to 2026-09-10 13:10 IST (2026-09-09 07:40 UTC to 2026-09-10 07:40 UTC)

This DLL component scan read, normalized, and deduplicated only `DLL_software_component.txt`. No credible vulnerability newly reported or materially updated within the last 24 hours could be matched confidently to a component and version in that inventory.

### Findings

No relevant new vulnerabilities were verified in the scan window.

The in-window GitHub Advisory Database results included four reviewed NuGet advisories and five reviewed npm advisories, but none affected a package in the DLL inventory. The apparent ASP.NET result, CVE-2026-69304, applies to `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.IISIntegration`; the inventory contains classic `Microsoft.AspNet.WebApi` packages, so it was excluded as a different product. Three additional in-window NuGet advisories affect `Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native`, which is not listed.

- **Source:** [GitHub Advisory Database - NuGet, exact cutoff](https://github.com/advisories?query=type%3Areviewed+ecosystem%3Anuget+created%3A%3E2026-09-09T07%3A40%3A01Z+sort%3Acreated-desc)
- **Source:** [GitHub Advisory Database - npm, exact cutoff](https://github.com/advisories?query=type%3Areviewed+ecosystem%3Anpm+created%3A%3E2026-09-09T07%3A40%3A01Z+sort%3Acreated-desc)

### MongoDB ecosystem sweep

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major officially maintained libraries and services. No fresh, credible MongoDB-related disclosure was verified inside this scan window.

MongoDB's authoritative alerts page showed its newest Server CVEs dated September 8, 2026, before the September 9 07:40 UTC cutoff; these were excluded as stale for this digest. [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Possible matches needing review

None.

### Closing

No immediate vulnerability review is recommended from this 24-hour DLL scan. Continue normal monitoring; this result does not assess older known vulnerabilities already affecting the listed versions.
